mapper.select: select activity_id, activity_name, source, discount_id, group_type, take_limit_count, target, valid_time, status, start_time, end_time, tag_id, tag_scope from group_buy_activity where source = #{source} and channel = #{channel} order by id desc limit 1

select activity_id, activity_name, discount_id, group_type, take_limit_count, target, valid_time, status, start_time, end_time, tag_id, tag_scope from group_buy_activity where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1

select activity_id, activity_name, discount_id, group_type, take_limit_count, target, valid_time, status, start_time, end_time, tag_id, tag_scope from group_buy_activity where activity_id = #{activityId}

select a.activity_id, a.activity_name, a.discount_id, a.group_type, a.take_limit_count, a.target, a.valid_time, a.status, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.tag_id, a.tag_scope, (select count(o.id) from group_buy_order_list o where o.user_id = #{userId} and o.activity_id = a.activity_id) as user_order_count, i.available_stock from group_buy_activity a left join ticket_calendar_inventory i on i.activity_id = a.activity_id and i.goods_id = #{goodsId} and i.travel_date = #{travelDate} and i.status = 1 where a.activity_id = #{activityId}
